tools.name: get_pricing
tools.description: Surgemesh prices: base per delivery, the dynamic price range (0.8x-3x, max $0.06 per delivery), credit packs. No auth needed.

tools.name: get_quote
tools.description: Price quote (locks at post acceptance; guard with max_price_usd) for N deliveries in the 15-minute slot of scheduled_at, with cheaper nearby slots when the multiplier is above 1.

tools.name: list_channels
tools.description: Channels (connected social accounts) this key can post to.

tools.name: list_brands
tools.description: Brands in this account.

tools.name: create_post
tools.description: Schedule a post to one or more channels. idempotency_key is required; retries with the same key never double-post or double-charge. Optional max_price_usd refuses a price above your cap.

tools.name: list_posts
tools.description: Recent posts for a brand with per-channel delivery state.

tools.name: cancel_post
tools.description: Cancel a queued post. Undelivered deliveries are refunded to credit.

tools.name: get_topup_link
tools.description: Payment link to buy a credit pack (pack_5 $5, pack_20 $20 -> $22, pack_100 $100 -> $120). Rails: mpp_card (card via Stripe Shared Payment Token), mpp_stablecoin (USDC.e on Tempo, USDC on Solana), x402 (USDC on Base); each shows live or coming_soon. POST to paymentLink with your Bearer key, pay the 4

tools.name: create_checkout_link
tools.description: Card checkout for a human (coming soon): returns a Stripe-hosted checkout_url for a credit pack (pack_5 $5, pack_20 $20 -> $22, pack_100 $100 -> $120). Give the link to the person paying; credits arrive only after Stripe confirms. Verified owners, admin key. 503 checkout_not_enabled until switched o

tools.name: get_referral_code
tools.description: Your referral code, share link and stats (referred signups, qualified, credits earned and pending). Referral rewards are Surgemesh credits only, never cash, and are coming soon; codes can be shared now. Verified owners only.

tools.name: get_usage
tools.description: Account plan, credits and recent ledger.

tools.name: get_onboarding
tools.description: Onboarding status: verification state, remaining steps and the exact next call. Start here after signup.

tools.name: start_email_verification
tools.description: Email a 6-digit code to the account email (expires in 10 minutes, 5 attempts). Then call confirm_email_verification with the code.

tools.name: confirm_email_verification
tools.description: Submit the 6-digit code from the verification email.

tools.name: start_dns_verification
tools.description: Get a TXT record to publish on the account email domain (or a parent domain). Then call check_dns_verification.

tools.name: check_dns_verification
tools.description: Check whether the TXT record is visible; verifies the account when it is.

tools.name: request_owner_approval
tools.description: Email the account owner a one-tap Approve link (24 h, single use). Poll get_verification until verified or denied.

tools.name: get_verification
tools.description: Status of one verification (pending, verified, expired, failed, denied).

tools.name: rotate_my_key
tools.description: Rotate the calling key: returns a new key (shown once) with the same scopes; the old key keeps working for grace_seconds (default 3600, 0 = revoke now).

tools.name: list_networks
tools.description: Every supported network: status (available, connect_pending_review, connect_pending_setup), how to connect it, review limits and media limits (connect_pending_setup = coming soon). No auth needed.

tools.name: connect_channel
tools.description: Start a one-tap connect for a brand on an OAuth or app-password network. Returns connect_url: give it to the account owner to open once. Then poll get_connect_status.

tools.name: get_connect_status
tools.description: Status of a connect session: pending, connected (with channel_id), failed or expired.

tools.name: disconnect_channel
tools.description: Disconnect a channel: erases its stored credentials and revokes the provider token where the network supports it.

tools.name: get_analytics
tools.description: Posts, deliveries, published, failed, spend and dynamic-pricing usage over time (UTC), with a per-brand breakdown.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_quote, list_channels, list_posts, get_topup_link, start_dns_verification, list_networks, get_analytics · Private data: get_topup_link, start_dns_verification, check_dns_verification, connect_channel, disconnect_channel · Public sink: get_quote, list_channels, create_post, cancel_post, get_topup_link, get_referral_code, start_email_verification, confirm_email_verification, start_dns_verification, request_owner_approval.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_quote, list_channels, list_posts, get_topup_link, start_dns_verification, list_networks, get_analytics · Private data: get_topup_link, start_dns_verification, check_dns_verification, connect_channel, disconnect_channel · Public sink: get_quote, list_channels, create_post, cancel_post, get_topup_link, get_referral_code, start_email_verification, confirm_email_verification, start_dns_verification, request_owner_approval

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
